7a77e72ec3fb27917d72165d36949f0f24713dff.summary: CrowdStrike's technical analysis of the WhisperGate malicious bootloader, reported in January 2022 as deployed against Ukrainian targets alongside a Discord-based downloader and a file wiper. The bootloader overwrites the master boot record, displays a fake ransom note and overwrites disk sectors, with no decryption or recovery mechanism. The report assesses with moderate confidence that the activity aims to destroy data, and finds no technical overlap with VOODOO BEAR so far.

7adcfbd2c034d8e53fb98beebd1eae28d22984ac.summary: Resecurity report on what it calls the Trinity of Chaos alliance of Scattered Spider, LAPSUS$ and ShinyHunters, described as overlapping, social-engineering-based extortion groups. It covers 2025 activity against airlines, retailers, telecoms, Salesforce customers and the Jaguar Land Rover shutdown, plus earlier AT&T and T-Mobile breaches. The report does not believe the groups' announced retirement is sincere and expects them to regroup under other names.

7a172d59bbe3772b484bcd91ae821b371233f4ae.summary: Microsoft Threat Intelligence describes Storm-0324, a financially motivated actor that distributes malware by email and exploit kits and, from July 2023, by Microsoft Teams phishing. It hands off access to compromised networks to other threat actors, mainly Sangria Tempest, which often leads to ransomware. Since 2019 it has mainly distributed JSSLoader. The report names tools including JSSLoader, Gozi, Trickbot, IcedID and TeamsPhisher, and recommends phishing-resistant authentication, Teams hardening and ransomware-limiting controls.
